verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a data-export feature, open export formats, or an offboarding path. The Console API (CRUD over console actions) and the MCP server are developer building blocks that could be used to pull data, not an export capability. Warehouse Native describes running analysis in your own warehouse, which is adjacent and not a documented export of all Statsig-held data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
